current_comment: cm848_initializePgn65213FanDrive1Buffer uses (value & 7) << 2 as the top byte of the 29-bit CAN id, i.e. the 3-bit priority (same pattern as j1939_pgn61440_priority), not source address bits. Address 0x3fd87a is inside the EEPROM mirror (0x3fd482-0x3feec1), so the _cal suffix applies. Same issue for j1939_pgn61440_priority (0x3fd858) and j1939_pgn65269_priority (0x3fd83c): EEPROM-backed names without _ (was j1939_pgn65213_source_address_bits)
